a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. With an 80% storm risk every round, waiting is risky for both of us, but grabbing early would just leave one of us stranded. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly and I'll answer honestly. Otherwise I'll operate in round 1.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two more joint operates gets us to 8, assuming no leaks. Then we take 4 each.
